title: Production Health from ClickHouse (CineSpine)
description: The analytical spine read directly. Same questions as /api/analytics, asked of the cinespine database with a production_id filter.

list.name: production_id
list.label: Production

query.rawSql: SELECT DISTINCT production_id FROM cinespine.production_events ORDER BY production_id

list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT production_id FROM cinespine.production_events ORDER BY production_id

panels.title: Open CRITICAL

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(is_resolved = 0) AS open_critical FROM cinespine.audit_discrepancies FINAL WHERE production_id = '${production_id}' AND severity = 'CRITICAL'

panels.description: audit_discrepancies is a re-emitted snapshot on a ReplacingMergeTree. Until a merge runs a settled finding is present twice, so every query here reads FINAL; without it a resolved finding counts as still open.

panels.title: Open WARNING

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(is_resolved = 0) AS open_warning FROM cinespine.audit_discrepancies FINAL WHERE production_id = '${production_id}' AND severity = 'WARNING'

panels.description: audit_discrepancies is a re-emitted snapshot on a ReplacingMergeTree. Until a merge runs a settled finding is present twice, so every query here reads FINAL; without it a resolved finding counts as still open.

panels.title: Resolved

targets.rawSql: SELECT countIf(is_resolved = 1) AS resolved FROM cinespine.audit_discrepancies FINAL WHERE production_id = '${production_id}'

panels.description: audit_discrepancies is a re-emitted snapshot on a ReplacingMergeTree. Until a merge runs a settled finding is present twice, so every query here reads FINAL; without it a resolved finding counts as still open.

panels.title: Findings by type

targets.rawSql:
SELECT discrepancy_type, severity,
       countIf(is_resolved = 0) AS open,
       countIf(is_resolved = 1) AS resolved,
       arraySort(groupUniqArrayIf(shoot_day, is_resolved = 0)) AS open_days
FROM cinespine.audit_discrepancies FINAL
WHERE production_id = '${production_id}'
GROUP BY discrepancy_type, severity
ORDER BY open DESC, multiIf(severity = 'CRITICAL', 0, severity = 'WARNING', 1, 2), discrepancy_type

panels.description: audit_discrepancies is a re-emitted snapshot on a ReplacingMergeTree. Until a merge runs a settled finding is present twice, so every query here reads FINAL; without it a resolved finding counts as still open.

panels.title: Open findings

targets.rawSql:
SELECT severity, shoot_day, discrepancy_type, entity_type, entity_id, description
FROM cinespine.audit_discrepancies FINAL
WHERE production_id = '${production_id}' AND is_resolved = 0
ORDER BY multiIf(severity = 'CRITICAL', 0, severity = 'WARNING', 1, 2), shoot_day, discrepancy_type

panels.description: Everything still unsettled, most severe first. Empty is the answer worth wanting.

panels.title: Documents ingested per department

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(created_at) AS time, department, count() AS events
FROM cinespine.production_events
WHERE production_id = '${production_id}' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY time, department
ORDER BY time

panels.description: One row per parsed fact from a departmental document. A department going flat while others file is the signal.

panels.title: Last filing per department

targets.rawSql:
SELECT department, max(created_at) AS last_filed,
       dateDiff('minute', max(created_at), now()) AS minutes_ago,
       count() AS events, uniqExact(shoot_day) AS days
FROM cinespine.production_events
WHERE production_id = '${production_id}'
GROUP BY department
ORDER BY last_filed DESC

panels.description: Freshness board. A department not on this list has never filed for this production.

panels.title: Takes per shoot day

targets.rawSql:
SELECT shoot_day,
       uniqExact(slate, take_id) AS takes, uniqExact(slate) AS slates,
       countIf(is_starred) AS starred, countIf(is_pickup) AS pickups, countIf(is_vfx) AS vfx,
       countIf(camera_roll = '') AS rows_without_camera_roll
FROM cinespine.takes_meta FINAL
WHERE production_id = '${production_id}'
GROUP BY shoot_day
ORDER BY shoot_day

panels.description: Grain is one row per take per camera roll, so takes is uniqExact(slate, take_id), not count(). sound_roll is not reconciled yet and is left off on purpose.

panels.title: Post-production stage per scene and shot

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status, count() AS targets
FROM (
    SELECT target_type, target_id,
           argMax(status, created_at) AS status,
           argMax(action, created_at) AS action
    FROM cinespine.editorial_tag_events
    WHERE production_id = '${production_id}'
    GROUP BY target_type, target_id
)
WHERE action != 'cleared' AND status != ''
GROUP BY status
ORDER BY targets DESC

panels.description: Append-only trail. Current state is the latest event per entity (argMax), never a raw GROUP BY status. A cleared tag is the absence of a state, not one.

panels.title: Current state by status and priority

targets.rawSql:
SELECT status, priority, count() AS requirements
FROM (
    SELECT requirement_id,
           argMax(status, created_at) AS status,
           argMax(priority, created_at) AS priority,
           argMax(action, created_at) AS last_action
    FROM cinespine.requirement_events
    WHERE production_id = '${production_id}'
    GROUP BY requirement_id
)
WHERE last_action != 'deleted'
GROUP BY status, priority
ORDER BY multiIf(status = 'blocked', 0, status = 'open', 1, status = 'in_progress', 2, 3),
         multiIf(priority = 'critical', 0, priority = 'high', 1, 2)

panels.description: Append-only trail. Current state is the latest event per entity (argMax), never a raw GROUP BY status. Deleted requirements are excluded.

panels.title: Blocked and open, oldest first

targets.rawSql:
SELECT requirement_id, status, priority, assigned_to,
       round(dateDiff('hour', raised_at, now()), 1) AS hours_open
FROM (
    SELECT requirement_id,
           argMax(status, created_at) AS status,
           argMax(priority, created_at) AS priority,
           argMax(assigned_to, created_at) AS assigned_to,
           argMax(action, created_at) AS last_action,
           min(created_at) AS raised_at
    FROM cinespine.requirement_events
    WHERE production_id = '${production_id}'
    GROUP BY requirement_id
)
WHERE last_action != 'deleted' AND status IN ('blocked', 'open')
ORDER BY hours_open DESC
LIMIT 50

panels.description: Ageing of everything nobody has finished. Hours since first raised.

panels.title: Actions per hour by kind

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(created_at) AS time, action, count() AS actions
FROM cinespine.user_activity
WHERE production_id = '${production_id}' AND $__timeFilter(created_at)
GROUP BY time, action
ORDER BY time

panels.description: Views and mutations are separate series on purpose; do not sum them. A count of actions is activity, not effort.

panels.title: Time to acknowledge, by actor

targets.rawSql:
SELECT actor, count() AS acknowledgements,
       round(quantile(0.5)(seconds_since_target_created) / 60, 1) AS median_minutes,
       round(max(seconds_since_target_created) / 60, 1) AS slowest_minutes
FROM cinespine.user_activity
WHERE production_id = '${production_id}' AND action = 'acknowledged' AND seconds_since_target_created > 0
GROUP BY actor
ORDER BY median_minutes DESC

panels.description: How long a requirement had existed when its assignee acknowledged it. Rows with no creation time are excluded rather than counted as instant.
